# hyperfluid_alert_rule (Resource)

An alert on one Monitoring panel of one resource, delivered through the alert channels. Needs the organization's `alerting_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alert when a Trino cluster has queries queued for ten minutes.
resource "hyperfluid_alert_rule" "trino_queue" {
  resource_kind  = "trino"
  resource_ref   = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  resource_name  = "my-lake"
  panel_id       = "trino_queued_queries"
  warning_value  = 10
  critical_value = 25
  for_seconds    = 600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `panel_id` (String) Panel to watch, e.g. `trino_queued_queries` (`hfctl alerting panels` lists them).
- `resource_kind` (String) Kind of the watched resource, e.g. `postgres`, `container_app` or `trino`.
- `resource_ref` (String) The watched resource: its id, a model's name, or `<environment_id>/<pool_name>` for a `github_runner_pool`.

### Optional

- `comparator` (String) `gt` fires above the thresholds, `lt` below them.
- `critical_value` (Number) Critical threshold.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is evaluated.
- `for_seconds` (Number) How long the condition must hold before the alert fires, up to 86400.
- `resource_name` (String) Name shown in alerts; defaults to `resource_ref`. Set by the platform for a `scheduled_query`.
- `warning_value` (Number) Warning threshold, crossed before `critical_value`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Alert rule import id is the rule id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_alert_rule.trino_queue 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
